model_annotation:
The plots illustrate the relationship between the IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote (debt ratio) for Gesamtstaat (total state) and Zentralstaat (central state) over time. Both plots share the same x-axis, representing years from 1995 to 2020 with a linear scale and tick labels at 5-year intervals. The left plot has a y-axis on the left labeled "IWF Fiskalindex" ranging from 0 to 2.5, and a y-axis on the right labeled "Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat" ranging from 60 to 120. The right plot has a y-axis on the left labeled "IWF Fiskalindex" ranging from -5 to 2, and a y-axis on the right labeled "Schuldenquote Zentralstaat" ranging from 30 to 70. 

The left plot shows two lines: a blue line representing the IWF Fiskalindex, which starts at around 0 in 1995, peaks at approximately 1 in 2008, and then declines to around 0.1 in 2020, and a purple line representing the Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat, which starts at around 60 in 1995, increases to around 100 in 2015, and then rises sharply to around 115 in 2020. The blue and red triangular markers represent the IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat data points, respectively.

The right plot also shows two lines: a blue line representing the IWF Fiskalindex, which starts at around -2 in 1995, peaks at approximately 1 in 2008, and then declines to around -4 in 2020, and a purple line representing the Schuldenquote Zentralstaat, which starts at around 35 in 1995, increases to around 50 in 2010, and then rises sharply to around 65 in 2020. The blue and red triangular markers represent the IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote Zentralstaat data points, respectively.
